pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large sub-polygonal and sub-rectangular dark regions with slightly rounded vertices. Edges exhibit relatively smooth pixel gradients rather than sharp, high-contrast transitions. Spatial area of dark patches is high relative to the inter-patch distance.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored pathways forming a topological graph with prominent 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. Pixel thickness is narrow but consistent throughout the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck mane, presenting as small, repetitive hair tufts against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A visible structural break or dip in the mane continuity is present at the transition zone between the distal neck and the shoulder ridge.
